{{Quote|Well, sister, sometimes I do ''amaze'' even myself!"<br />"So do I, Solo. So do I.|Han Solo and Fem Nu-Ar|<ref name="marvel84" />}}
'''Fem Nu-Ar''' was an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologist]] who worked alongside [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Ualp Xathan]] during the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Nu-Ar and Xathan were pressed into service by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Drezzel]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], who tasked them with studying the ruins of an ancient [[Human/Legends|Human]] civilization on [[Seoul 5]]. Nu-Ar and Xathan uncovered a large cache of powerful [[Seoularian crystal]]s within the city, leading to their imprisonment as the Empire seized the crystals for itself for weapons development. The two archaeologists were freed by treasure seeker [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who activated the [[crystal control room]] and caused a massive explosion that destroyed the archaeological site and the Imperial forces&mdash;Nu-Ar and Xathan escaped along with the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] on his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'', where a grateful Nu-Ar gave Solo a kiss.<ref name="marvel84" />
